items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 165:1
items.html: If the screen does not hold back the light of the GAR, it is called a near screen, since it has some closeness to Hochma, and this closeness is called GAR, which is not the essence but the power of the GAR in Ima. But the screen of Yetzirah, which holds back the light of the GAR completely, is called a distant screen. (Items 36 and 37).
